title: ring(144, 4, 144) with junction corners: the same 288-slot loop and 144 docks, height 4
claim: The same loop and docks again, on a rectangle of height 4: once more the same programme, instruction for instruction and cool for cool, on a different device. Drawn at height 4, some dock rails cross without a junction (V100 and V142 among them), so R21 refuses the device and it is listed under Disqualified, never ranked.

marks.label: R21 fails on this device
marks.note: rails V100 (S100-A100) and V142 (S142-A142) cross without a junction; rails may only cross at a node they share

marks.label: rigid rotation
marks.note: one loop_shift template turns the whole loop: every rider moves with one waveform, 144 ions here. This is the broadcast primitive the ring is built around. Every loaded site the rotation does not move -- a docked ancilla -- HOLDS meanwhile: its two-way switch selects the hold bank instead of the motion bank, 1 select bit per site per cycle. A switchless channel cannot hold a docked ion while it moves the loop (R4d).

marks.label: batch 1 of 411
marks.note: a dock: 10 riders pull into their spurs at once. Each batch pays dock + undock + one forced cool (about 725 us) whatever its size; mean fill here is 2.1 contacts of 11 possible.

marks.label: forced cool
marks.note: 300 us, once per batch: an ion that has crossed a junction carries 3 quanta against a 1-quantum gate budget, so the cool is structural, not a policy. Cooling is 13% of the round.

marks.label: contact gates (10 pairs at once)
marks.note: the two-qubit gates of one batch, all in one instruction; each pair sits in its own dock. The Circuit pane shows which QASM statements this discharges.

marks.label: undock
marks.note: the riders leave their spurs. Entering the degree-3 rail node is charged as a junction crossing -- the price of the only mechanism a loop has.

marks.label: the fullest batch (11 contacts)
marks.note: every ancilla in use at once: this is what the lockstep placement is engineered to make happen, and the per-batch overhead is amortised best here.

marks.label: a 1-contact batch (207 of 411)
marks.note: one rider docks alone, and the batch still pays its full overhead: 207 such batches cost about 151.1 ms for 24.0% of the contacts.

title: ring(146, 2, 144) with junction corners: a dock for every check -- the release's starter
claim: The release's starter. Each of the 144 check ions waits in a dock of its own, and the 144 data ions ride a loop of 288 slots, one in every second slot.
